text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, D, E and C because they were above my average cost does not by itself make the sale sound; I should assess each trade by its future risk and return, not the comfort of realizing a gain.","After several periods of small account swings and no trades, I should remember that doing nothing can be reasonable when there is no compelling, portfolio-wide reason to act.","I should not let my reluctance to admit a loss keep me holding a position; decide using current prospects and risk limits, regardless of my purchase price."]}
